item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 26 August 2026
item.description:
DAILY BRIEFING. Wednesday 26 August 2026.
Weather. Another correction, because this forecast will not sit still. Yesterday I told you today was thirty-five millimetres of rain and Thursday the wet one at forty-one. Both wrong. Today is seventeen to twenty-seven degrees, partly…

item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 02 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip today, fourteen to twenty, grey lid, five and a half millimetres of rain, wind to eight metres a second. Correction, because this forecast has lied to me three days running: yesterday I promised you twelve millimetres and a proper soaking, and it is half that.…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 25 August 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip. Twenty-five today, clear sky, and three point seven millimetres of rain that will find you the moment you leave without a jacket. Fifteen overnight. Dress for two seasons, carry the third. Now. Yesterday I told you Wednesday was a fifty-eight millimetre…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 01 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip today, twelve to twenty, solid grey lid, no rain, no wind worth the name. Twenty and cloudy is the weather equivalent of being told your table will be ready shortly. It's nothing. It's beige. Take the jacket you'll resent carrying, because you will carry it.…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 27 August 2026
item.description:
DAILY BRIEFING. Thursday 27 August 2026.
Weather. Third correction in three days and I am taking it personally. Yesterday I told you today was seventy-seven millimetres, a bucket over the head, cancel everything. It is forty-eight. Still wet, still grim, just less biblical.…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 03 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip today, eighteen to twenty-four, cloudy, three point three millimetres of rain. Correction, four days running now: yesterday I promised it would warm and dry at once. Half right. Twenty-four, yes. Dry, absolutely not. Rain at twenty-four degrees, the muggy…

item.title: Briefing — Sunday 30 August 2026
item.description:
Sunday 30 August 2026. Digest built 06:35 today.
WEATHER. Ruislip. Fifteen to twenty-one degrees and twenty-three and a half millimetres of rain, on a bank holiday Sunday, because of course. Twenty-one does not mean sunny, it means warm rain, the worst rain there is, the sort…

item.title: Briefing — Sunday 23 August 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip. Thirteen to twenty-three, clear sky, zero rain, wind barely five metres a second. A flawless day and you will waste it. Twenty-three is the exact temperature where you convince yourself a jacket is sensible and then carry the bloody thing round for six hours…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 29 August 2026
item.description:
Saturday 29 August 2026. Digest built 06:35 today.
WEATHER. Ruislip. Sixteen to twenty degrees and sixty-nine point six millimetres of rain. Sixty-nine. That is not a shower, that is a bucket emptied over your head, and the forecast still files it as partly cloudy. Correction,…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 22 August 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip today. Eleven this morning, twenty-one this afternoon, fair, zero rain, wind that couldn't move a crisp packet. Eleven to twenty-one is the worst kind of day, because you dress for eleven, you commit, and by two you're carrying a coat around like a punishment.…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 05 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip. Twelve to twenty-two, partly cloudy, not one millimetre of rain. Twenty-two and dry in September is the weather being polite, which should frighten you, because it never lasts. Twelve at dawn, twenty-two by lunch, so layers, and no, the shorts stay in the…

item.title: Briefing — Monday 24 August 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip, rest of today: twenty-one degrees and dry, not a millimetre of rain. Twenty-one. In late August. That is not summer, that is summer phoning it in. Fifteen overnight, so take a layer this evening, and no, the T-shirt is not fine, you will stand there pretending…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 28 August 2026
item.description:
DAILY BRIEFING. Friday 28 August 2026.
Weather. Fourth day running I have to walk something back. Yesterday I told you Friday was thirty-four millimetres. It is eleven. Then I promised you a dry Sunday. It is nine. Marvellous. Today: fourteen to twenty-three, partly cloudy,…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 04 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip today, fourteen to twenty, cloudy, two point two millimetres. Correction time, now a standing feature. Yesterday I promised Friday was the wet one, four and a half millimetres. It is two point two. I overcharged you by half. I also sold you low twenties. It is…
